calls.reason: The 70–90% figure is an explicit wager. The packet holds only Anthropic's funding announcement, and nothing measures how much global compute revenue depends on lab financing.
Amazon's AI run rate above $25B and Google Cloud's 82% AI-driven growth hint at stronger results, but neither excludes the labs. Nothing addresses why the companies disclose what they do.
A conditional forecast with no deadline. Epoch's data excludes actual utilization, and no records show full use or permanent non-use of any defined capacity.
A conditional claim. Microsoft says nearly 90% of cloud revenue comes from outside frontier labs, which only weakens the premise for one company, and no payment-loss analysis exists for all three.
JLL's forecast of about 100 GW added and up to $3T invested by 2030 makes the claim plausible, but it covers future additions, not the August construction pipeline, and gives no revenue requirement.

NVIDIA says its balance-sheet-backed labs will be about a quarter of next year's business and one lab bought capacity independently. That undercuts 'entirely', but it is company say-so and doesn't test the counterfactual.
